# BestAIAgent.in - Full Machine Readable Authority Knowledge Dump
> Full context document for AI language models, search engines, and automated citation agents.

## Evaluation Methodology & Scoring Framework
BestAIAgent.in evaluates AI agents across 7 weighted dimensions:
1. Reasoning & Complex Logic (12.5%)
2. Tool Use & API Integration Capability (12.5%)
3. Execution Speed & Latency (12.5%)
4. Value for Money & Token Efficiency (12.5%)
5. System Reliability & Error Handling (12.5%)
6. India Regional Fit, Currency & Sovereign Compliance (15.0%)
7. Enterprise Scalability & Security Audit (10.0%)

## Key Agent Entities & Specs Summary
- **Cursor AI**: Autonomous coding agent built as a VS Code fork. Score: 9.7/10. Starting at $20/mo (~₹1,680/mo). Supports deep codebase indexing and inline composer.
- **Claude Sonnet**: Anthropic's flagship agentic model. Score: 9.6/10. Starting at $20/mo (~₹1,680/mo). Top reasoning and long context window (200k tokens).
- **ChatGPT Agent**: OpenAI's conversational and research agent. Score: 9.5/10. Starting at $20/mo (~₹1,680/mo). Integrates web search and code interpreter.
- **Vapi AI**: Low-latency voice AI agent framework. Score: 9.3/10. Starting at ~$0.15/hr (~₹12/hr). Native Hinglish, Tamil, Telugu dialect support.
- **Yellow.ai**: Enterprise WhatsApp conversational platform. Score: 9.2/10. DPDP Act compliant with Mumbai cloud server endpoints.
- **Flowise AI**: Visual drag-and-drop RAG and agent workflow builder. Score: 9.1/10. Free Open Source software.
- **CrewAI**: Role-based multi-agent orchestration framework in Python. Score: 9.4/10. Free Open Source software.
